# P36.38 — Search API serving v2 (row 379, K13 SRCH-03)

Stacked PR — head `r11/P36.38-search-api-serving-v2`, base
`r11/P36.37-map-app-shell` (never `main`).

## What lands

- **`GET /v1/releases/{pub or latest}/search`** — the federated v2
  serving route (`api/release_search_v2.py` + the env-gated mount in
  `app.py`): one request across **every** licence compartment
  (SIG-SRCH-001), each compartment's records a labelled licence group
  with its own cursor, match-quality order with a stated `matched`
  reason per result (SIG-SRCH-003).
- **Streaming verify-and-copy + LRU** — each `sig.release-search-index/2`
  artifact streams to a local copy in 1 MiB chunks while hashing;
  sha256 + byte_size must match the release integrity manifest before
  any `mode=ro` open (K3 §5.5 / NEW-2). A bounded LRU (default 2) of
  open engines; eviction drops the verified copies.
- **`latest` via conf-gen** (REL-05) — resolves `latest.json`; no
  pointer → 503 `no_current_release`. Pub-pinned answers are
  `public, max-age=31536000, immutable`; `latest` `max-age=300`.
- **The withdrawal barrier** — the same one P32.5 policy at access
  time: route/namespace deny → 410 + tombstone; entity denies direct;
  claim denies resolve through `claim_ref` once per request; denials
  counted into `scope.excluded_records_by_reason` (DR-C4-09).
- **No query logging** (SIG-SRCH-012) — the module never logs a query
  string; a fixture pin asserts it. Per-client rate limits are the
  P36.13 app-wide token bucket keyed on the LB-appended client address.
- **`SIG_API_SEARCH_V2` posture** — `off` (default) mounts nothing:
  the public response is identical to pre-roll; `on` serves; an unknown
  value refuses boot. `format=html` answers a typed 501 — P36.39 owns
  the no-JS representation.
- **`sig-api` 512 MiB → 1 GiB** — `D-K3-5 [B-30] = yes` carried
  verbatim (+$3/mo): `SIG_API_MEMORY` in `ops/gcp/config.sh` +
  `provision.sh --memory` declare it for fresh provisions.
- **The staged roll** — `ops/gcp/search-v2-roll.sh`
  (check/apply/verify; AR-3 + AR-2 window guard, verbatim-go author
  env) + `docs/build/reports/p36.38-search-v2-roll/` packet.

## Requirement stamps

**SIG-UI-076** (release-pinned data only) · **SIG-SRCH-001** (all
compartments in one request) · **SIG-SRCH-003** (match-quality
ordering) · **SIG-SRCH-012** (no query logging).
Cited: SIG-UI-039, SIG-UI-040, SIG-ENG-042, SIG-REL-010, SIG-API-009
(P36.13's enforcement), `D-K3-5 [B-30] = yes` (verbatim).

## IN-TICKET PAUSE — the roll is queued

The production API roll is **never pre-authorised** (OM-20 — it changes
a public route's response): the code, store, LRU, roll runner and
packet land; the roll itself queues for the operator's explicit
verbatim go, recorded `prepared_not_executed` → **D-P36.38-1** (OPEN,
obligation anchor `D-P36.38-1:e0`, `return_pass` row `P36.38` +
`P36.38-roll` leg). Re-run:
`implement-spec spec=docs/tickets/379_P36.38__search-api-serving-v2.md live_verification=true`.
The serving code ships dark either way — `off` mounts nothing.
